fieldValues.title: Declared strata, drilled one layer at a time
fieldValues.move: Each document type declares its strata (an ordered list of layers, each naming its record types), and every reader view opens a record one stratum down along rests-on relations only, showing back (earlier documents), across (standing records) and around (where it is filed) as separate directions.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not make the lower layers correct; a wrong fragment is still wrong, only easier to find. Does not decide which strata a new document type needs.
fieldValues.falsifier: On a second, different document (the Party Utility season) the declared strata do not hold: many rests-on relations go up a stratum within one document, or readers given the stratum view take as long as with the graph to find what a minute rests on.
fieldValues.return_when: Readers ask to see relations the strata hide more often than they use the drill.
